newsitem.title: USA: Grant Geophysical offering off, sees charge.
newsitem.headline: Grant Geophysical offering off, sees charge.

text.p: Grant Geophysical Inc said Wednesday that the convertible debentures offering valued at $15.2 million has been terminated.
In a release Wednesday Grant said that the agreement, signed with Westgate International LP and the Liverpool LP for the issuance of Grant convertible debentures, was terminated by the lenders.
Grant said that it will continue to explore sources of working capital and implement a restructuring of operations, for which it expects to take a charge in the fourth quarter of 1996.
